ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated in this runtime against the pinned SHA-256.
All three printed page markers, retrospective diary body, gambling rules, gambling-session notes, process-of-play rules, rules for society, and all sixteen apparatus notes are represented.
Испанские замки is retained by its historical idiom as castles in Spain rather than replaced by a modern paraphrase such as pipe dreams.
придерживать in денежные игры is rendered back another player's stake, following Dahl's contemporary dictionary definition: приставлять свою ставку ко ставке другого.

The gambling calculations are translated mechanically without correcting their arithmetic or reconciling body readings with manuscript variants, including body 3 versus note 1 1/2 and body 120 versus note 100.

The source literally has 9 тыс. сер. и 29 сер.; English preserves this as 9 thousand silver rubles and 29 silver rubles rather than silently supplying a second thousand. Eikhenbaum later printed/interpreted the second figure as 29 thousand, but that interpretation is not inserted into Tolstoy's translated body.
палки is kept as the historical card-game name palki; удар is rendered coup in the gambling context. The numerical notation following it is preserved unchanged.
Three uninterpretable truncated deletions (вост, стре, нахо) and one further deleted fragment (вдв) are transliterated in the apparatus rather than guessed into complete English words.
